name: Isometric Squat Tendon Hold
desc: Lower into 90-degree parallel squat and hold statically under heavy continuous load for collagen remodeling.

name: Achilles Tendon Eccentric Drop
desc: Rise onto toes on bench step, then slowly lower heel below step level over 5 seconds under controlled load.

name: Scapular Plane Full-Can Scaption
desc: Raise dumbbells at 30-degree forward angle in scapular plane with thumbs slightly up to heal rotator cuff.

name: Slow Eccentric Hammer Curl
desc: Strict neutral-grip hammer curl with a focused 5-second slow lowering phase for elbow tendon recovery.

name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
desc: In a forearm side plank, lift your top leg up, then lower it slowly. Keep your hips high. Switch sides halfway.

name: Bridge March
desc: Hold a glute bridge. Lift one knee towards your chest without dropping your hips, put it down, then the other.

name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
desc: Lie on your back with knees bent. Push through your heels to lift your hips, hold for two seconds, then lower slowly.

name: Bench Straight-Leg Hip Raise
desc: Lie on the bench holding the end behind your head. Raise your straight legs to vertical and lift your hips slightly, then lower over three seconds.

name: Leg Raise With Hip Lift
desc: Lie flat, raise your legs to vertical, then lift your hips a few centimetres off the mat. Lower your hips, then your legs slowly.

name: Bench Lying Leg Raise
desc: Lie on the bench holding the end behind you. Raise your legs to vertical, then lower slowly until they are level with the bench.

name: Deep Squat Hold
desc: Sink into a deep squat with heels down, elbows inside your knees. Hold and breathe, gently pushing your knees out.

name: Seated Bench Leg Raise
desc: Sit on the bench, hands behind you. Lift your straight legs up and lower slowly without touching the floor.

name: Twisting Leg Raise
desc: Lie flat and raise your legs, then lower them diagonally to one side. Return to centre and lower to the other side.

name: Bench Lying Leg Raise (Slow Eccentric)
desc: Lie on a flat bench holding the edge behind your head. Raise straight legs to vertical, then lower them over 5 seconds without arching your back.

name: Incline Bench Alternating Hammer Curl
desc: Rest your upper arms over an incline backrest, palms in. Curl one dumbbell up, lower over three seconds, then the other.

name: Seated Alternating Hammer Curl
desc: Sit tall, palms facing in. Curl one dumbbell up, lower it over three seconds, then the other. Builds elbow tendon strength.

name: Seated Bench Curl (5s Eccentric)
desc: Sit tall on the end of a flat bench. Curl both dumbbells up in 2 seconds, pause for 1, then lower over 3 seconds to load the biceps tendon.

name: Standing Single-Arm Curl (Distal Biceps HSR)
desc: Stand tall with your elbow pinned to your side. Curl up for 2 seconds, hold for 1, and lower for 3 seconds. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Squat With Biceps Curl
desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Squat down, then as you stand up curl the dumbbells. Lower them slowly.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
desc: Curl one dumbbell across your body towards the opposite shoulder, palm in. Lower slowly and switch.

name: Seated Bench Hammer Curl (Elbow Tendon HSR)
desc: Sit on a flat bench with palms facing in. Curl both dumbbells up, pause, and lower over 3 seconds to strengthen the elbow tendons.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
desc: Stand with palms facing in. Curl both dumbbells up without swinging, then lower over three seconds.

name: Incline Bench Hammer Curl
desc: Sit back on an incline bench, arms straight down, palms in. Curl up and lower slowly into the stretch.

name: Single-Arm Incline Hammer Curl
desc: Rest one upper arm over an incline backrest, palm in. Curl up and lower over three seconds.

name: Prone Bench Single-Arm Hammer Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, one arm straight down, palm in. Curl up and lower slowly.

name: Seated Single-Arm Hammer Curl
desc: Sit tall, one dumbbell palm in. Curl up and lower over three seconds. Switch arms.

name: Standing Single-Arm Hammer Curl
desc: Stand tall, palm in. Curl one dumbbell up and lower over three seconds. Switch arms.

name: Incline Bench Hammer Preacher Curl
desc: Rest both upper arms over an incline backrest, palms in. Curl up and lower slowly.

name: Prone Incline Hammer Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, palms in. Curl both dumbbells up and lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Alternate Hammer Curl
desc: Lie back on a 45-degree incline bench with arms straight down by your sides. Hammer curl one arm at a time, lowering slowly over 3 seconds.

name: Seated Hammer Curl
desc: Sit on the bench, palms in. Curl both dumbbells up, then lower over three seconds.

name: Bench Concentration Curl (Slow Eccentric)
desc: Sit on the end of a bench with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Curl up, squeeze for 1 second, then lower over 4 seconds.

name: Hammer Curl and Press
desc: Curl one dumbbell up with palm in, press it overhead, lower it to your shoulder and then to your side. Alternate arms.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
desc: Stand tall, lightly holding a wall. Rise onto your toes over two seconds, pause, and lower over three.

name: Wall Calf Stretch (Bent Knee)
desc: Hands on a wall, one foot back with the heel down. Bend the back knee slightly to stretch the lower calf and Achilles. Switch legs.

name: Wall Calf Stretch (Straight Leg)
desc: Hands on a wall, one leg back with the knee straight and heel down. Lean in to stretch the calf. Switch legs.

name: Bent-Over Calf Raise
desc: Lean forward with your hands on the bench, hips back. Rise onto your toes, pause, and lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
desc: Sit on the bench, dumbbells resting on your knees. Lift your heels as high as you can, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
desc: Sit with one dumbbell on one knee. Raise that heel high, pause, and lower over three seconds. Switch legs.

name: Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise (Heel Drop)
desc: Sit with your toes on a dumbbell handle and a dumbbell on your knee. Lower the heel below the toes, then rise up high.

name: Seated Single-Leg Soleus Raise
desc: Sit with a dumbbell on one knee, knee at 90 degrees. Lift the heel, hold for two seconds, lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Calf Raise
desc: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and the wall with the other. Rise on one foot, pause, and lower over three seconds.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Rise onto your toes, squeeze, and lower over three seconds.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise (Achilles HSR)
desc: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell at your side, other hand on a wall. Rise up in 2 seconds, hold for 1, and lower for 3 seconds.

name: Seated Bench Calf Raise (Soleus HSR)
desc: Sit on a bench with dumbbells resting on your knees. Raise your heels as high as you can, hold for 1 second, and lower over 3 seconds.

name: Bent-Knee Wall Calf Raise
desc: Face a wall with your knees slightly bent and hands on the wall. Rise onto your toes, hold for 1 second, and lower over 3 seconds, keeping the knee bend.

name: Bent-Over Single-Leg Calf Raise
desc: Hands on the bench, hips back, one foot lifted. Rise onto the toes of the standing foot and lower slowly.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
desc: Stand on one foot, lightly holding a wall. Rise as high as you can and lower slowly. Switch legs.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
desc: Sit with your legs straight. Loop your hands around one foot and pull the toes towards you. Hold, then switch.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise on Dumbbell
desc: Stand with the ball of one foot on a dumbbell handle on the floor, holding a wall. Lower the heel, then rise up high.

name: Calf Raise on a Step
desc: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or the bench edge. Lower your heels slowly below the step, then rise high.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
desc: Step one foot forward and lean onto it with the back heel pressed down. Hold, then switch legs.

name: Bent-Over Calf Raise With Dumbbell
desc: Hands on the bench, hips back, a dumbbell tucked in your hip crease. Rise onto your toes and lower slowly.

name: Mini Squat Jump
desc: Bend your knees into a quarter squat, then jump a few centimetres and land softly back into the quarter squat.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
desc: Raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height with straight arms, then lower over three seconds.

name: Full-Can Raise
desc: Thumbs up, raise light dumbbells at a 30-degree angle in front of your body to shoulder height. Lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Incline Lateral Raise
desc: Lie on your side on an incline bench. Raise the top dumbbell up and out to vertical, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Front Raise
desc: Lie back on an incline bench. Raise the dumbbells in front of you to vertical with straight arms, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Prone Rear Lateral Raise
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Raise light dumbbells out to the sides, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Incline Prone T-Raise
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, thumbs up. Raise your arms straight out to the sides into a T, hold, and lower.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
desc: Raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lower over three seconds.

name: Lateral to Front Raise
desc: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, bring them round to the front at shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Prone Floor Rear Delt Raise
desc: Lie face down with light dumbbells. Lift your arms out to the sides off the floor, squeeze, and lower.

name: Side-Lying Single-Arm Rear Raise
desc: Lie on your side and raise the top dumbbell from in front of your chest up to the ceiling. Lower slowly.

name: Prone Bench Rear Lateral Raise
desc: Lie chest-down on a flat bench. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Supported Single-Arm Lateral Raise
desc: Hold a wall with one hand and lean away slightly. Raise the dumbbell out to the side and lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Lateral Raise
desc: Raise one dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height, then lower over three seconds. Switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Scaption Raise
desc: Thumbs up, raise the dumbbells forward at a 30-degree angle to shoulder height. Lower slowly.

name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
desc: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out to the sides, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Head-Supported Rear Lateral Raise
desc: Bend forward and rest your forehead on the incline bench. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides and lower slowly.

name: Standing Rear Lateral Raise
desc: Hinge forward with a flat back. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides and lower slowly.

name: Seated Alternating Front Raise
desc: Sit on the bench and raise one dumbbell in front to shoulder height, lower slowly, then the other.

name: Seated Bent-Arm Lateral Raise
desc: Sit with elbows bent at 90 degrees. Raise your elbows out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Front Raise
desc: Sit tall and raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, then lower over three seconds.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
desc: Sit tall and raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height. Lower over three seconds.

name: Side-Lying Lateral Raise
desc: Lie on your side on the mat. Raise the top dumbbell from your thigh up to vertical, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Alternating Front Raise
desc: Raise one dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height, lower slowly, then the other.

name: Front Raise to Overhead
desc: Raise the dumbbells in front of you all the way overhead with straight arms, then lower slowly.

name: Curtsy Squat
desc: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower into a squat. Return and switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Squat to Bench
desc: Hold dumbbells and squat back until you lightly touch the bench, then stand up. Slow on the way down.

name: Light Dumbbell Squat Jump
desc: Hold light dumbbells at your sides. Squat and jump up, landing softly back into the squat.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Squat to Bench
desc: Hold a light dumbbell, stand on one leg in front of the bench and lower slowly to touch it. Stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Squat
desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Squat down with your chest tall to thighs level, then stand up. Lower over three seconds.

name: Frankenstein Squat
desc: Hold your arms straight out in front at shoulder height. Squat down keeping your chest upright, then stand.

name: Glute Bridge March
desc: Hold a glute bridge. Lift one foot off the floor, put it down, then the other, keeping your hips level.

name: Feet-on-Bench Glute Bridge
desc: Lie with your heels on the bench. Push your hips up until your body is straight, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Jump Squat
desc: Squat down and jump up explosively, landing softly with bent knees. Reset and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Heels-Elevated Squat (Patellar HSR)
desc: Elevate heels 5cm on bench base or rolled mat. Descend for 5 slow eccentric seconds to direct tensile load strictly through patellar tendon fibers.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
desc: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest. Hinge hips back, sink between knees into deep 90-degree parallel squat.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
desc: Hinge backward at hips with flat spine and soft knees. Lower dumbbells down shins for deep hamstring load.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
desc: Step backward with control on mat, dropping rear knee to 90 degrees, drive upward through front heel.

name: Weighted Glute Bridge Lockout
desc: Lie on mat, dumbbell on hip crease. Drive heels through floor into full hip extension with 2s lockout.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
desc: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent for balance. Raise your top leg up and slightly back with the toes pointing forward, then lower slowly.

name: Straight-Leg Side Raise
desc: Lie on your side with both legs straight. Lift the top leg to about 45 degrees, hold for a second, then lower slowly. Switch sides.

name: Butterfly Stretch
desc: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and knees out. Hold your feet and let your knees sink towards the floor. Breathe slowly.

name: Side-Lying Inner Thigh Raise
desc: Lie on your side, top foot planted in front of your bottom knee. Lift the straight bottom leg up a few centimetres, then lower slowly.

name: Side Plank Inner Thigh Lift
desc: In a side plank on your forearm, lift your top leg up, then bring the bottom leg up to meet it. Lower slowly.

name: Ankle Circles
desc: Sit or stand on one leg. Draw slow, large circles with your ankle, then reverse the direction. Switch feet halfway.

name: Single-Leg Step-Down From Bench
desc: Stand on one leg on a flat bench holding a light dumbbell. Lower the free heel to tap the floor over 3 seconds, then drive back up.

name: Knee Circles
desc: Stand with feet together and hands on your knees. Circle your knees slowly one way, then the other.

name: Outer Calf Stretch
desc: Sit with legs out. Turn one foot inwards and pull the toes gently towards you until you feel the outside of the shin stretch.

name: Inner Calf Stretch
desc: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front. Lean your knee forward over the foot until you feel the inner calf stretch.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
desc: Hands on a wall, one leg back with the heel down and knee straight. Lean in until you feel the calf stretch. Switch legs.

name: Lying Glute Stretch
desc: Lie on your back and pull one knee across your body towards the opposite shoulder. Hold and breathe, then switch.

name: Lying Piriformis Stretch
desc: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull that thigh towards you. Hold, then switch.

name: Standing Toe Touch
desc: Stand tall, then hinge forward with soft knees and reach towards your toes. Hold, then roll up slowly.

name: Bench Glute Hip Extension
desc: Lie face down with your hips on the end of the bench, holding on. Lift your legs until they are level with your body, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Lying Knee Drop Twist
desc: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms out wide. Let both knees fall slowly to one side, hold, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Clean
desc: Hinge with the dumbbells by your knees. Drive your hips forward to pull them up and catch them at your shoulders with a slight knee bend. Lower and repeat.

name: Forward Lunge (Opposite-Hand Dumbbell)
desc: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg. Step forward into a lunge, lower slowly, then push back. Switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
desc: Dumbbells in front of your shins, back flat. Push through your feet and stand up tall, then lower them back down slowly.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step forward and lower until both knees are at 90 degrees, then push back. Alternate legs.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Snatch
desc: Hinge with one dumbbell between your feet. Drive your hips forward and pull the dumbbell straight up overhead in one move. Lower and switch.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
desc: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step back and lower your back knee towards the floor, then drive through the front heel to stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
desc: Soft knees, dumbbells in front of your thighs. Push your hips back and slide them down your legs to a hamstring stretch, then stand tall.

name: Bench-Assisted Single-Leg Deadlift
desc: Lightly touch the bench with one hand. Hinge on one leg, the other leg reaching back, then stand up. Switch legs.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Deadlift
desc: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell. Hinge forward as the free leg reaches back, keep your hips square, then stand up slowly.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
desc: Hold dumbbells and step one foot up onto the bench. Drive through that heel to stand on top, then step down slowly.

name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
desc: Keep your knees almost straight. Hinge forward and lower the dumbbells to mid-shin, then stand up by squeezing your glutes.

name: Dumbbell Straight-Leg Deadlift (Slow)
desc: Knees nearly straight, hinge forward over three seconds to a deep hamstring stretch, then return.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull-Through
desc: Stand wide holding one dumbbell between your legs. Hinge back to swing it gently behind you, then drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
desc: Kneel on the mat in a lunge. Squeeze the back glute and shift your hips forward. Hold for 30 seconds each side, breathing slowly.

name: Prone Hip Rotation On Mat
desc: Lie face down with knees bent to 90 degrees. Let your feet fall slowly outward and back in, keeping your hips pressed into the mat.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge With Dumbbell
desc: Lie on the mat with a dumbbell on one hip and that foot planted. Drive up through the heel, pause at the top, and lower over 3 seconds.

name: Prone Flutter Kicks
desc: Lie face down, hands under your forehead. Lift your legs and kick them up and down in small movements, squeezing your glutes.

name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge
desc: Step forward and lower until both knees are at 90 degrees. Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Circular Toe Touch
desc: Stand wide, hands clasped. Reach down to one foot, sweep across to the other and rise up in a circle. Change direction halfway.

name: Hug Knees to Chest
desc: Lie on your back and hug both knees into your chest. Rock gently side to side and breathe.

name: Lying Iron Cross Stretch
desc: Lie face up, arms out wide. Swing one straight leg across your body towards the opposite hand, hold, then switch.

name: Jumping Lunge
desc: From a lunge, jump and switch legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge on the other side. Advanced.

name: Wall Sit March
desc: Hold a wall sit with thighs level. Lift one foot a few centimetres, put it down, then the other. Keep your back on the wall.

name: Bench Reverse Hyper
desc: Lie face down on the bench with hips on the end. Lift both legs until level with your body, squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Rocking Frog Stretch
desc: On your forearms and knees, spread your knees wide. Rock your hips back and forward gently to stretch the inner thighs.

name: Seated Glute Stretch
desc: Sit on the bench and cross one ankle over the opposite knee. Lean forward with a straight back until you feel the glute stretch.

name: Seated Piriformis Twist
desc: Sit with one leg straight, the other foot crossed over it. Hug the knee and twist towards it. Switch sides.

name: Prone Swimmer Kicks
desc: Lie face down, arms forward. Lift the opposite arm and leg, then switch in a steady swimming rhythm.

name: Glute Bridge With Twist
desc: Lift into a glute bridge, rotate your hips slightly to one side, back to centre, then lower. Alternate sides.

name: Walking Lunge
desc: Step forward into a lunge, then bring the back foot through into the next lunge. Turn around when you run out of space.

name: Dumbbell Deep Lunge Hold
desc: Hold dumbbells and sink into a long lunge. Hold the bottom position and breathe, then switch legs.

name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
desc: Lie on your back and raise one straight leg, holding behind your thigh. Pull it gently towards you and hold.

name: Prone Dumbbell Leg Curl
desc: Lie face down with a light dumbbell held between your feet. Curl your heels towards your glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Mat Hamstring Stretch
desc: Sit tall on the mat with one leg straight. Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back and hold for 30 seconds each side.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
desc: Put one heel on the bench, leg straight. Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch. Switch legs.

name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch
desc: Lie on your back and raise one leg straight up. Flex your foot and hold the stretch, then switch.

name: Runner's Stretch
desc: From a lunge, straighten the front leg and sit your hips back, reaching towards your front foot. Switch legs.

name: Seated Wide-Leg Stretch
desc: Sit with your legs wide. Walk your hands forward between your legs and breathe into the stretch.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
desc: Step into a deep lunge, place the opposite hand down and rotate your other arm up to the ceiling. Return and switch sides.

name: All-Fours Quad Stretch
desc: On hands and knees, reach back with one hand and hold the opposite foot, pulling the heel towards your glutes.

name: Prone Quad Stretch
desc: Lie face down and bend one knee, holding the foot and pulling the heel towards your glutes. Switch legs.

name: Backward Hop
desc: Stand tall, hop backwards a short distance and land softly with bent knees. Step forward and repeat.

name: Step-Up to Reverse Lunge
desc: Step up onto the bench with dumbbells, step back down and straight into a reverse lunge. Repeat on the same leg, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
desc: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides, stand tall and walk slowly, or march on the spot if space is tight.

name: Broad Jump
desc: Swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can, landing softly. Walk back and repeat.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
desc: Kneel in a lunge, hold your back foot and pull it towards your glutes while pushing your hips forward. Switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
desc: Lie on your side and pull your top heel towards your glutes, knees together. Switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat (Bench)
desc: Elevate rear foot on bench laces-down. Hold dumbbells at sides. Descend vertically for 3s until back knee hovers 2cm above mat, explode up.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (Tempo 3-1-1)
desc: Hinge hips backward with soft knee bend. Slide dumbbells along shins for 3s eccentric stretch, pause 1s at mid-shin, squeeze glutes to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Wide-Stance Sumo Squat
desc: Stand with feet 1.5x shoulder width, toes angled 45 deg out. Hold heavy dumbbell vertically. Sink hips down vertically into deep groin stretch.

name: Dumbbell Step-Ups on Bench
desc: Place lead foot flat on flat bench. Drive through lead heel to stand tall, minimizing push-off from trail leg. Control lowering for 3s.

name: Mat Single-Leg Dumbbell Glute Bridge
desc: Lie supine on mat, place dumbbell across hips. Extend one leg straight in air, drive through working heel to full 2s glute lockout.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
desc: Step working trail leg diagonally behind lead leg. Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to mat, loading outer hip and glute medius.

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat on Mat
desc: Wide lateral stance on mat. Shift weight onto one leg, sinking deep while keeping trail leg completely straight with toes pointing ceiling-ward.

name: Mat Frog Pumps with Dumbbell
desc: Lie on mat with soles of feet pressed together and knees flared wide. Rest dumbbell across lower pelvis. Bridge hips into peak glute contraction.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise (Edge of Bench/Mat)
desc: Place balls of feet on base of bench/riser. Lower heels deep for 3s stretch, then explode onto toes with a 2s peak contraction hold at top.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat 5-Second Isometric Hold
desc: Lower into split squat with front thigh parallel to mat. Freeze isometrically for 5s at lowest point before driving back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell B-Stance Romanian Deadlift (Mat)
desc: Kickstand back foot on toe, loading 90% bodyweight on lead front leg. Hinge hips back into deep hamstring stretch, 3s descent.

name: Mat Sissy Squat Quadriceps Isolation
desc: On mat, push knees forward over toes while leaning torso backward in straight line from knees to shoulders. 4s slow eccentric return.

name: Bench Nordic Hamstring Eccentric Fall
desc: Kneel on mat with heels secured under bench. Lower torso toward mat resisting with hamstrings as long as possible before catching in push-up.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
desc: Lie flat on mat, press dumbbells vertically with controlled 5s eccentric lowering until upper arms touch floor.

name: Archer Push-Up
desc: Set your hands very wide. Lower towards one hand while the other arm stays straight, then press back up. Alternate sides each rep. Advanced.

name: Hands-Behind-Head Chest Stretch
desc: Stand or kneel tall with your fingers laced behind your head. Draw your elbows back to open the chest and breathe slowly.

name: Wall Chest and Shoulder Stretch
desc: Place one forearm on a wall at shoulder height. Step through and turn your body away until you feel the chest stretch. Switch sides.

name: Bench Chest Stretch
desc: Kneel facing a bench with elbows resting on it and hands together. Sink your chest toward the floor and hold for 30 seconds.

name: Push-Up With Chest Tap
desc: Do a push-up. At the top, lift one hand and tap your opposite shoulder without twisting your hips. Alternate hands each rep.

name: Clap Push-Up
desc: Lower into a push-up, then push explosively so your hands leave the floor and clap. Land with soft elbows. Advanced and powerful.

name: Clock Push-Up
desc: Do a push-up, then walk your hands a step around in a circle with your feet still. Do the next push-up there and keep going round.

name: Decline Push-Up
desc: Put your feet on the bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders. Lower your chest slowly, pause, then press up. Works the upper chest.

name: Deep Push-Up on Dumbbells
desc: Hold dumbbell handles on the floor so your chest can sink below your hands. Lower slowly into the deep stretch, then press up.

name: Bench Pullover
desc: Lie across the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands. Lower it behind your head slowly with soft elbows, then pull it back up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
desc: Lie on the bench, dumbbells at chest level. Press them up until your arms are straight, then lower over two seconds with elbows at about 45 degrees.

name: Floor Bridge Press (Decline Angle)
desc: Lie on the mat, lift your hips into a bridge and hold. Press the dumbbells up from your chest and lower slowly. The bridge gives a decline angle.

name: Floor Bridge Fly (Decline Angle)
desc: Hold a glute bridge on the mat. With soft elbows, open your arms wide until they near the floor, then hug the dumbbells back together.

name: Single-Arm Floor Bridge Fly
desc: Hold a glute bridge. Open one arm out wide with a soft elbow and bring it back over your chest. Switch arms each set.

name: Floor Fly With Palm Turn
desc: Lie on the mat. Lower the dumbbells out wide with palms up, then bring them together and turn your palms to face each other at the top.

name: Flat Bench Dumbbell Fly
desc: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above your chest and a soft bend in the elbows. Open wide over 3 seconds, then bring them back together.

name: Floor Dumbbell Fly
desc: Lie on the mat with dumbbells over your chest. Open your arms wide with soft elbows until your upper arms touch the floor, then squeeze them back together.

name: Incline Bench Alternating Press
desc: Sit back on an incline bench. Press one dumbbell up while the other waits at your chest, lower slowly, then switch.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
desc: Set the bench to about 30 degrees. Press both dumbbells up over your upper chest, then lower slowly to chest level.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell Fly
desc: Set the bench to a 30-degree incline. With soft elbows, open the dumbbells wide over 3 seconds, feel the stretch, and bring them back up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
desc: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells over your chest. Open your arms wide with soft elbows to a stretch, then bring them back together.

name: Incline Bench Single-Arm Fly
desc: On a 30-degree incline bench, fly one dumbbell out to the side over 3 seconds and back up. Keep your hips level. Switch arms after the set.

name: Incline Single-Arm Fly
desc: On an incline bench, open one arm out wide with a soft elbow, then bring it back over your chest. Switch arms.

name: Incline Bench Single-Arm Press
desc: On a 30-degree incline bench, lower one dumbbell to your chest over 3 seconds, then press it up. Brace your core so you don't tip.

name: Incline Single-Arm Press
desc: On an incline bench, press one dumbbell up and lower it slowly. Keep your core tight so you don't twist.

name: Incline Neutral-Grip Press
desc: On an incline bench, palms facing each other, press the dumbbells up and lower slowly. Easier on the shoulders.

name: Low-Incline Bench Dumbbell Press
desc: Set the bench to a low 15 to 20 degree incline. Lower the dumbbells to your chest over 3 seconds, pause, then press up.

name: Incline Fly With Palm Turn
desc: On an incline bench, lower the dumbbells wide with palms up, then bring them together, turning your palms in at the top.

name: Floor Single-Arm Press (Slow)
desc: Lie on the mat and press one dumbbell up. Lower it over three seconds until your elbow touches the floor. Switch arms.

name: Floor Single-Arm Press
desc: Lie on the mat and press one dumbbell straight up, then lower it until the elbow touches the floor. Switch arms.

name: Flat Bench Dumbbell Pullover
desc: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with both hands. Lower it behind your head over 3 seconds, then pull it back over.

name: Bench Single-Arm Fly
desc: Lie on the bench, one dumbbell over your chest. Open the arm out wide with a soft elbow, then bring it back. Hold the bench with the other hand.

name: Floor Single-Arm Fly
desc: Lie on the mat with one dumbbell above your chest. Open the arm out until your elbow touches the floor, then bring it back up slowly.

name: Single-Arm Floor Bridge Press
desc: Hold a glute bridge on the mat and press one dumbbell up, lowering slowly. Switch arms each set.

name: Flat Bench Single-Arm Fly
desc: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell above your chest. Open it out to the side over 3 seconds and back up, keeping the other hand on your hip.

name: Incline Single-Arm Chest Press
desc: Lie on an incline bench. Press one dumbbell up over your shoulder and lower slowly to chest level.

name: Flat Bench Single-Arm Press
desc: Lie on a flat bench pressing one dumbbell. Lower it over 3 seconds and press up without letting your body twist.

name: Single-Arm Bench Pullover
desc: Lie on a flat bench with one dumbbell above your chest. Lower it in an arc behind your head over 3 seconds, then pull it back over.

name: Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Bench Press
desc: Lie on the bench, palm facing your face. Press the dumbbell up and lower slowly with your elbow close to your side.

name: Floor Fly With Glute Bridge
desc: Hold a glute bridge on the mat with dumbbells above your chest. Open your arms wide over 3 seconds and bring them back, keeping your hips up.

name: Floor Press With Glute Bridge
desc: Lift your hips into a glute bridge on the mat. Lower the dumbbells over 3 seconds until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up.

name: Cross-Bench Dumbbell Pullover
desc: Lie across a flat bench with only your upper back on it and hips low. Lower one dumbbell behind your head over 3 seconds, then pull it back over your chest.

name: Floor Dumbbell Pullover
desc: Lie on the mat with knees bent, holding one dumbbell above your chest. Lower it behind your head until it nearly touches the floor, then bring it back.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
desc: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest. Lower it behind your head with slightly bent elbows, then pull it back up over your chest.

name: Reverse-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
desc: Lie on the bench with palms facing towards you. Press up and lower slowly with elbows close in. Targets the upper chest.

name: Straight-Arm Pullover
desc: Lie on the bench, arms straight over your chest holding one dumbbell. Lower it behind your head with arms straight, then lift it back.

name: Dynamic Chest Opener
desc: Stand tall and swing your arms out wide to open your chest, then cross them in front. Keep it easy and rhythmic.

name: Bench Pike Push Up
desc: Place your feet on a bench and walk your hands back so your hips are high. Lower your head toward the floor over 3 seconds and press back up.

name: Incline Push-Up (High Bench)
desc: Hands on a high bench or step, body straight. Lower your chest to the edge slowly, then press up. Easier than a floor push-up.

name: Incline Push-Up
desc: Hands on the bench, feet back, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to the bench slowly, pause, then press up.

name: Incline Reverse-Grip Push-Up
desc: Hands on the bench with fingers pointing towards your feet. Lower slowly with elbows close, then press up.

name: Isometric Dumbbell Chest Squeeze
desc: Hold one dumbbell between your palms at chest height. Press your hands together as hard as you can and hold, breathing steadily.

name: Kneeling Push-Up
desc: Knees on the mat, hands under your shoulders, body straight from knees to head. Lower your chest slowly and press up.

name: Explosive Floor Press (Light Dumbbells)
desc: Lie on the mat with light dumbbells. Lower them over 3 seconds, then press up as fast as you can with control at the top.

name: Kneeling Push Up (Slow Eccentric)
desc: Kneel on the mat with hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest to the floor over 3 seconds, then push back up.

name: Incline Push Up On Bench
desc: Put your hands on the edge of a bench with your body straight. Lower your chest to the bench over 3 seconds and press away.

name: Decline Push Up (Feet On Bench)
desc: Put your feet on a bench and hands on the floor. Lower your chest over 3 seconds, keeping your body in a straight line, then push up.

name: Diamond Push Up
desc: Make a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers under your chest. Lower over 3 seconds with elbows close to your ribs, then push up.

name: Hindu Push-Up
desc: Start with hips high. Dive your chest down and forward between your hands, then push up into a cobra. Reverse back to hips high.

name: Explosive Push-Up
desc: Lower into a push-up and press up hard so your hands just leave the floor. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

name: Wide Push Up (5s Lowering)
desc: Place your hands wider than your shoulders. Take 5 full seconds to lower your chest to the floor, then push back up.

name: Staggered-Hand Push Up
desc: Place one hand slightly forward and one back. Lower over 3 seconds and push up. Swap hand positions halfway through the set.

name: Dumbbell Handle Push Up
desc: Grip two hex dumbbells on the floor, shoulder-width apart. Lower your chest between them over 3 seconds for a deeper stretch, then push up.

name: Push-Up Plus
desc: At the top of a push-up, push the floor away further so your upper back rounds slightly. Lower your chest, press up and push again.

name: Wall Push-Up
desc: Stand facing a wall, hands on it at shoulder height. Lean in slowly until your nose nearly touches, then push back. The easiest push-up.

name: Push-Up
desc: Hands under your shoulders, body straight from head to heels. Lower your chest to the floor slowly, pause, then press up.

name: Push-Up to Shoulder Tap
desc: Do a push-up, then tap each shoulder with the opposite hand while keeping your hips still.

name: Single-Arm Push-Up (Advanced)
desc: Feet wide, one hand under your chest, other hand behind your back. Lower slowly and press up. Use an incline bench to make it easier.

name: Push-Up to Superman
desc: Do a push-up, lower to the floor, then lift your arms and legs into a superman. Lower and press back up.

name: Dumbbell Svend Press
desc: Squeeze one dumbbell between your palms at your chest. Press it straight out in front, keep squeezing, then bring it back.

name: Bench Dip (Slow Eccentric)
desc: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, and slide off. Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees over 3 seconds, then push up.

name: Wide Push-Up
desc: Hands wider than your shoulders. Lower your chest slowly between your hands, pause, then press up.

name: Incline Scapular Push-Up
desc: Hands on the bench, arms straight. Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades, then push the bench away. Arms stay straight.

name: Scapular Push-Up
desc: In a high plank with straight arms, let your shoulder blades squeeze together, then push the floor away to spread them.

name: Bench Scapular Dip
desc: Hands on the bench behind you, arms straight. Let your shoulders rise towards your ears, then push down to lift your body. Arms stay straight.

name: Standing Overhead Triceps Extension
desc: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows, then straighten your arms. Elbows point up.

name: Bench Dip (Knees Bent)
desc: Hands on the bench edge behind you, knees bent, feet flat. Lower your hips until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then press up.

name: Floor Triceps Dip
desc: Sit on the mat, hands behind you, fingers forward. Lift your hips, bend your elbows to lower, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Tate Press (Bench)
desc: Lie on 30-degree bench with bells over chest. Flare elbows out wide, bend elbows inward bringing dumbbell ends to touch chest, press up.

name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Floor Press (Mat)
desc: Lie on mat with dumbbells pressed together at midline. Keep bells in continuous contact throughout 3s lowering until triceps touch floor.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
desc: Hinge forward 45 degrees, pull dumbbells towards hips leading with elbows, squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Seated Leg-Assisted Concentration Curl
desc: Sit on the bench, hold one dumbbell and brace that elbow against the inside of your thigh. Curl up slowly, squeeze at the top, then lower for a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Biceps Curl
desc: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward. Curl one arm up while the other stays down, lower slowly, then switch. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.

name: Incline Bench Alternating Preacher Curl
desc: Kneel behind an incline bench with your upper arms resting on the backrest. Curl one dumbbell up, lower it slowly until the arm is nearly straight, then switch arms.

name: Seated Bench Alternating Bicep Curl
desc: Sit tall on a flat bench. Curl one dumbbell at a time, squeeze at the top, and lower over 3 seconds.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Biceps Curl
desc: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in each hand. Curl both up without swaying, then lower slowly. Switch the standing leg each set to train balance as well.

name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Curl
desc: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing back. Curl up with your wrists straight, keeping elbows by your sides, then lower slowly. This works the forearms and the brachialis.

name: V-Sit Dumbbell Bicep Curl
desc: Sit on the mat leaning back with feet lifted in a V. Curl both dumbbells while holding the position, lowering over 3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
desc: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms forward. Curl both up without swinging, squeeze at the top, then lower for two seconds to a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
desc: Sit on the end of the bench, lean forward and rest your elbow against your inner thigh. Curl the dumbbell up to your shoulder, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell High Curl
desc: Raise your upper arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms up. Curl the dumbbells towards your ears, squeeze, then straighten your arms slowly without dropping the elbows.

name: Incline Bench Biceps Curl
desc: Lie back on a bench set to about 45 degrees, arms straight down. Curl both dumbbells up without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly into the stretch.

name: Incline Bench Alternating Curl
desc: Sit back on an incline bench with your arms straight down. Curl one dumbbell at a time, keeping the upper arm still, and lower slowly before switching.

name: Incline Bench Outward Curl
desc: Sit back on an incline bench, palms facing forward and slightly out. Curl the dumbbells up and outwards towards your shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Tall-Kneeling Dumbbell Curl
desc: Kneel tall on the mat with hips locked forward. Curl both dumbbells without leaning back, then lower over 3 seconds.

name: Reverse Lunge With Biceps Curl
desc: Step back into a reverse lunge, holding dumbbells at your sides. As you stand back up, curl both dumbbells, then lower them slowly. Alternate legs.

name: Floor Supine Biceps Curl
desc: Lie on your back on the mat with your upper arms on the floor and elbows bent. Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, then lower slowly until the forearms touch the mat.

name: Floor Wide-Arm Curl
desc: Lie on the mat with your arms out at 45 degrees, palms up. Curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders without lifting your upper arms, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Prone Single-Arm Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with one arm straight down. Curl the dumbbell up, squeeze hard at the top, then lower slowly to a straight arm.

name: Incline Bench Single-Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
desc: Rest one upper arm over the backrest of an incline bench, palm down. Curl the dumbbell up with a straight wrist, then lower slowly.

name: Prone Bench Single-Arm Reverse Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, one arm straight down with the palm facing back. Curl up with a straight wrist and lower slowly.

name: Seated Bench Single-Arm Curl
desc: Sit on a flat bench and curl one dumbbell with your elbow at your side. Lower over 3 seconds, finish the set, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Standing Curl
desc: Stand tall holding one dumbbell, free hand on your hip. Curl up without leaning, squeeze, and lower for two seconds. Finish one side, then the other.

name: Incline Bench Single-Arm Zottman Curl
desc: With your arm over an incline backrest, curl up palm up. At the top turn the palm down and lower slowly, then turn it back up at the bottom.

name: Bench Neutral-Grip Wrist Curl
desc: Kneel beside the bench and rest your forearms on it, thumbs up, hands over the edge. Lift the dumbbells by bending your wrists upwards, then lower slowly.

name: Bench Single-Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
desc: Rest one forearm on the bench, thumb up, hand over the edge. Raise the dumbbell by bending only the wrist, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Preacher Curl
desc: Stand behind an incline bench with your upper arm resting on the back pad. Curl up, then lower over 3 seconds until the arm is nearly straight.

name: Incline Bench Preacher Curl (Both Arms)
desc: Kneel behind an incline bench with both upper arms on the backrest. Curl the dumbbells up, then lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: Incline Bench Prone Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms straight down. Curl both dumbbells up without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Overhand Curl
desc: Hold the dumbbells palms down. Curl up keeping your wrists straight and elbows still, then lower over two seconds.

name: Incline Bench Reverse Preacher Curl
desc: Rest your upper arms over an incline backrest, palms down. Curl the dumbbells up, then lower slowly to a nearly straight arm.

name: Prone Bench Reverse Curl
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms straight down, palms facing back. Curl up with straight wrists and lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Biceps Curl
desc: Sit tall on the end of the bench, dumbbells at your sides. Curl both up, squeeze, then lower slowly without leaning back.

name: Seated Outward Curl
desc: Sit on the bench, palms facing forward and slightly out. Curl the dumbbells up and out towards your shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Neutral-Grip Wrist Curl
desc: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, thumbs up, hands past your knees. Bend your wrists to lift the dumbbells, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Thigh-Supported Preacher Curl
desc: Sit on the bench and rest the back of your upper arm on your thigh. Curl the dumbbell up, then lower slowly to a straight arm. Switch arms.

name: Seated Reverse-Grip Concentration Curl
desc: Sit, lean forward and brace your elbow against your thigh, palm down. Curl up with a straight wrist, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Concentration Curl
desc: Hinge forward with one hand on your knee and the working arm straight down. Curl the dumbbell towards your chest, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Outward Curl
desc: Stand tall, palms facing forward and slightly out. Curl the dumbbells up and outwards, keeping elbows close, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Single-Arm Concentration Curl
desc: Lean forward with your free hand on the bench, working arm straight down. Curl the dumbbell up to your shoulder and lower slowly.

name: Standing Single-Arm Incline Preacher Curl
desc: Stand behind an incline bench and rest one upper arm on the backrest. Curl the dumbbell up, then lower slowly to a nearly straight arm.

name: Standing Single-Arm Reverse Curl
desc: Hold one dumbbell palm down. Curl up with a straight wrist and the elbow still, then lower slowly. Finish one side, then switch.

name: Standing Incline Preacher Curl
desc: Stand behind an incline bench, upper arms on the backrest. Curl both dumbbells up and lower slowly.

name: Standing Reverse Curl
desc: Stand tall, palms down. Curl both dumbbells up with straight wrists and lower over two seconds.

name: Standing Zottman Preacher Curl
desc: Over an incline backrest, curl up palms up, turn palms down at the top, lower slowly, then turn back up at the bottom.

name: Bench Step-Up With Biceps Curl
desc: Step up onto the bench and balance on that leg. Curl both dumbbells at the top, lower them, then step down slowly. Alternate legs.

name: Dumbbell Waiter Curl
desc: Hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms under the top plate. Curl it up to your chest, keeping elbows in, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
desc: Curl up with palms facing up. At the top, turn palms down and lower slowly, then turn them back up at the bottom.

name: Incline Bench Zottman Curl
desc: With your upper arms on an incline backrest, curl up palms up, turn palms down at the top and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Finger Curl
desc: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms up. Let the dumbbell roll down to your fingertips, then curl your fingers and wrist back up.

name: Single-Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
desc: Rest one forearm on your thigh, palm down, hand past the knee. Lift the back of your hand up, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Single-Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
desc: Rest your forearm on your thigh, thumb up. Tilt the dumbbell up by bending your wrist, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Wrist Curl
desc: Rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up, hand past the knee. Curl your wrist up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Bench Single-Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
desc: Kneel and rest one forearm on the bench, palm down, hand over the edge. Lift the back of your hand up and lower slowly.

name: Bench Single-Arm Wrist Curl
desc: Kneel and rest one forearm on the bench, palm up, hand over the edge. Curl the wrist up and lower slowly.

name: Bench Reverse Wrist Curl
desc: Kneel beside the bench, forearms on it, palms down. Lift both hands up by bending the wrists, then lower slowly.

name: Bench Wrist Curl
desc: Kneel beside the bench, forearms on it, palms up. Curl both wrists up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Reverse Wrist Curl
desc: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms down. Lift the backs of your hands and lower slowly.

name: Seated Wrist Curl
desc: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up. Curl the wrists up, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
desc: Hold one arm straight out, palm up. With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back towards you until you feel a stretch in the forearm. Hold, then switch.

name: Doorway Lat and Chest Stretch
desc: Hold a wall edge at shoulder height and turn away from it, letting your chest and the front of your shoulder open. Breathe slowly and switch sides.

name: Prone Y Raise On Mat
desc: Lie face down on the mat with arms overhead in a Y. Lift both arms a few centimetres, hold for 2 seconds, and lower slowly.

name: Child's Pose Lat Stretch
desc: Kneel and sit back on your heels with arms reaching forward on the mat. Walk your hands to one side and hold for 30 seconds each side.

name: Cat-Cow Spine Mobiliser
desc: On hands and knees, round your back slowly toward the ceiling, then let it sag and lift your chest. Move with your breath for 10 slow cycles.

name: Side-Lying Open Book Stretch
desc: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms together in front. Open the top arm across to the other side and hold for 5 seconds. Repeat each side.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
desc: Kneel facing the bench, place your elbows on it and sit your hips back. Let your chest sink towards the floor to stretch the lats.

name: Chest-Supported Incline Dumbbell Row
desc: Lie face down on a 30-degree incline bench. Row both dumbbells to your ribs, squeeze for 1 second, and lower over 3 seconds.

name: Single-Arm Wall Lat Stretch
desc: Stand side-on to a wall, reach one arm high on the wall and lean your hips away. Hold, breathe, then switch sides.

name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
desc: Sit on the mat with your legs crossed. Walk your hands forward and round your back gently. Breathe into your lower back.

name: Side-Lying Lat Stretch
desc: Lie on your side with the top arm reaching overhead. Let the arm sink back and reach long through the fingertips. Switch sides halfway.

name: Standing Side Stretch
desc: Stand tall, reach one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side. Keep your hips still and breathe into the stretch. Switch sides.

name: Neck Side Stretch
desc: Sit or stand tall. Tilt your ear towards your shoulder and rest your hand on your head without pulling. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Neck Diagonal Stretch
desc: Turn your head 45 degrees and look down towards your armpit. Let the weight of your hand gently increase the stretch. Switch sides.

name: Prone Superman Hold
desc: Lie face down on the mat. Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor and hold for 3 seconds, then lower.

name: Bench Reverse Hyperextension
desc: Lie face down along a flat bench with your hips at the end, holding its sides. Lift both legs to level behind you, then lower over 3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Incline Spider Curl (Bench)
desc: Lie chest down on 45-degree bench with arms extended vertically toward floor. Curl dumbbells with strict isolated bicep contraction, 3s lowering.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
desc: Sit tall on bench with back supported, press dumbbells vertically overhead without lumbar arching.

name: Seated Curl to Press
desc: Sit on the bench. Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders, then press them overhead. Lower to your shoulders and then to your sides slowly.

name: Standing Alternating Side Press
desc: Hold the dumbbells at your shoulders. Press one up while leaning slightly away from it, lower slowly, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
desc: Start with dumbbells at your chin, palms facing you. Rotate your palms forward as you press overhead, then reverse on the way down.

name: Seated Bench Shoulder Press
desc: Sit with your back against an upright bench. Press the dumbbells overhead and lower slowly to ear height.

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
desc: Pull light dumbbells up to an upright row, rotate your forearms up so your fists point to the ceiling, then press overhead. Reverse slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front-to-Side Raise
desc: Raise light dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height, open them out to the sides, then lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying External Rotation
desc: Lie on your side, elbow tucked at 90 degrees with a light dumbbell. Rotate your forearm up towards the ceiling, then lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Rear Delt Raise
desc: Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in your top hand. Raise your straight arm up to the ceiling, then lower slowly.

name: Bench-Supported Single-Arm Reverse Fly
desc: Lean on the bench with one hand. Raise the dumbbell out to the side with a soft elbow, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Shoulder Press
desc: Stand tall, one dumbbell at your shoulder. Press it overhead without leaning, then lower slowly. Switch arms.

name: Single-Arm Upright Row
desc: Hold one dumbbell in front of your thigh. Pull it up to chest height with the elbow leading, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
desc: Dumbbells at your shoulders. Dip your knees slightly, then drive up through your legs to press the dumbbells overhead. Lower slowly.

name: Rear Delt Row
desc: Hinge forward, palms facing back. Row the dumbbells up and out with your elbows wide, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Bent-Over Rear Fly
desc: Hinge forward with a flat back. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides with soft elbows, squeeze your shoulder blades, and lower slowly.

name: Seated Bent-Over Reverse Fly
desc: Sit on the end of the bench and lean forward over your knees. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Fly With Rotation
desc: Bent over, raise the dumbbells out to the sides and rotate your thumbs up at the top. Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Scott Press
desc: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward and elbows out wide. Press up and slightly in, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Alternating Shoulder Press
desc: Sit tall on the bench. Press one dumbbell overhead while the other waits at your shoulder, then switch.

name: Seated Alternating Front Raise
desc: Sit on the bench and raise one dumbbell in front to shoulder height, lower slowly, then the other.

name: Seated Neutral-Grip Press
desc: Sit tall, palms facing each other. Press the dumbbells overhead and lower slowly to shoulder level.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
desc: Sit tall on the bench. Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight, then lower slowly to ear height.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Hold
desc: Press one dumbbell overhead and lock it out. Stand tall and hold, ribs down, breathing steadily. Switch arms.

name: Standing Alternating Overhead Press
desc: Stand tall, dumbbells at your shoulders. Press one up, lower slowly, then press the other.

name: Standing Around-the-World
desc: Hold light dumbbells at your thighs. Raise them out to the sides and up overhead in a wide arc, then lower the same way.

name: Standing Single-Arm Neutral Press
desc: Hold one dumbbell at your shoulder, palm in. Press overhead and lower slowly. Switch arms.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
desc: Stand tall with dumbbells at your shoulders. Press them overhead without leaning back, then lower slowly.

name: Standing Neutral-Grip Press
desc: Stand with palms facing each other. Press the dumbbells overhead and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
desc: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs. Pull them up to chest height, elbows leading and out to the sides, then lower slowly.

name: Standing 90/90 External Rotation
desc: Raise your elbows to shoulder height, bent at 90 degrees with forearms forward. Rotate the forearms up to vertical, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell W Press
desc: Start with dumbbells by your shoulders in a W shape, palms forward. Press up and slightly together, then lower slowly back to the W.

name: Cross-Body Rear Shoulder Stretch
desc: Bring one arm across your chest and hug it in with the other arm. Keep the shoulder down and breathe. Switch arms.

name: Weighted Arm Circles
desc: Hold light dumbbells with arms straight out to the sides. Make small circles forward, then backward.

name: Prone Bench Shrug
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms straight down. Shrug your shoulder blades back and up, hold, and lower slowly.

name: Incline Bench Shrug
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Pull your shoulder blades together and up, hold for a second, then lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
desc: Stand tall with heavy dumbbells at your sides. Shrug your shoulders straight up towards your ears, hold, and lower slowly.

name: Side Plank With Dumbbell Reach
desc: In a forearm side plank, hold a light dumbbell in your top hand. Raise it up to the ceiling and lower slowly. Switch sides.

name: Seated Dumbbell Arnold Press
desc: Sit tall on the bench with the dumbbells at your chin, palms facing you. Turn your palms forward as you press overhead, then reverse the turn as you lower.

name: Incline Prone Rear Delt Flyes
desc: Lie chest-down on 45-degree incline bench, fly dumbbells outward with thumbs down.

name: Incline Dumbbell Y-Raises
desc: Lie prone on incline bench, raise dumbbells in Y-shape for rotator cuff stability.

name: Seated Lateral Raise on Bench
desc: Sit tall on the end of the bench, dumbbells at your sides. Raise them out to shoulder height without swinging, then lower over three seconds.

name: Incline Prone T-Raises
desc: Chest supported on bench, raise dumbbells perpendicular to torso squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
desc: Lie on side on mat, rotate dumbbell upward keeping elbow pinned to flank.

name: Prone Cobra on Mat with Dumbbells
desc: Lie face down on mat, peel chest off floor while retracting light dumbbells.

name: Seated Dumbbell Front Raise on Bench
desc: Sit tall against the backrest. Raise both dumbbells in front of you to eye level with straight arms, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press on Bench
desc: Upright row into external rotation, then press overhead in one fluid kinetic flow.

name: Bench Prone W-Raises
desc: Chest-down on incline bench, pull elbows back and externally rotate hands into W formation.

name: Dumbbell Face Pull to External Rotation
desc: Hinge forward over the bench, arms straight down. Pull the dumbbells up towards your eyes with elbows high, then rotate your knuckles back. Reverse slowly.

name: Standing Dumbbell Upright Row
desc: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs. Pull them up along your body to upper-chest height, leading with your elbows, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Hammer Shoulder Press
desc: Sit tall with the dumbbells at your shoulders, palms facing each other. Press overhead and lower slowly. The neutral grip is kind to sore shoulders.

name: Mat Kneeling Dumbbell Halo
desc: Kneel on mat, circle single dumbbell smoothly around crown of head in tight perimeter.

name: Dumbbell Scapular Shrugs on Incline Bench
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms straight down. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and back, hold for a second, then relax slowly.

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press (Bench)
desc: Sit upright against bench. Start palms facing chest at chin level. Rotate outwards while driving overhead to locked lockout. Reverse smoothly.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell Y-Raise
desc: Lie chest-down on 45-degree incline bench with light dumbbells. Raise arms at a 45-degree Y-angle with thumbs pointed upward. Hold peak 2s.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell T-Raise
desc: Prone on incline bench. Raise arms perpendicular to torso in a T formation, squeezing scapulae tightly together at top of stroke.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell W-Raise
desc: Prone on bench. Pull elbows back at 90 degrees and externally rotate hands toward ceiling, forming a W shape. 3s eccentric lowering.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell L-Raise & Cuban Rotation
desc: Prone on bench. Row elbows to 90 degrees, then rotate forearms up into external rotation parallel to head. Maintain constant cuff tension.

name: Mat Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
desc: Lie on side on mat, tuck towel under top elbow at 90 degrees. Rotate dumbbell from mat up toward ceiling. Strict 3s lowering.

name: Mat Prone Cobra Scapular Retraction
desc: Lie chest-down on mat. Lift chest and rotate thumbs outward toward ceiling, retracting shoulder blades as hard as possible for 3s hold.

name: Dumbbell Standing Cuban Press
desc: Upright row to chest height, rotate forearms 180 degrees up until knuckles face ceiling, press overhead to lockout. Reverse the chain.

name: Dumbbell Seated Cuban Press (Bench)
desc: Seated on flat bench with strict posture. Perform high pull to chest, externally rotate into goalpost arms, and press overhead smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Leaning Single-Arm Lateral Raise
desc: Grasp bench with non-working hand and lean torso outward at 20 degrees. Raise dumbbell in lateral plane to shoulder height, 3s lowering.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest-Supported Rear Delt Row
desc: Lie chest down on 30-degree incline bench. Flare elbows out wide at 75-90 degrees to isolate posterior deltoids without lat takeover.

name: Dumbbell Wide-Grip High-Pull Upright Row
desc: Lead with elbows pulling dumbbells wide to chest level, keeping wrists lower than elbows to preserve subacromial joint space.

name: Dumbbell Neutral-Grip Overhead Press (Bench)
desc: Seated on bench. Position dumbbells with palms facing each other to minimize shoulder impingement while pressing to vertical lockout.

name: Dumbbell Around-The-World on Flat Bench
desc: Lie supine on bench holding light dumbbells. Arc weights in a complete semicircular path from hips overhead and back, arms straight.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise with Isometric Top Pause
desc: Raise dumbbells in front of torso to eye level. Freeze for 2s at horizontal peak, then control lowering over 3 slow seconds.

name: Mat Pike Push-Up (Bodyweight Shoulder Press)
desc: Hips folded high in an inverted V on mat. Lower crown of head forward between hands for 3s eccentric, press back up to inverted V.

name: Bench Feet-Elevated Pike Push-Up
desc: Place toes on flat bench with hands on mat. Hips piked 90 degrees. Lower forehead in front of fingers, pressing vertically through delts.

name: Mat Prone Floor Angel & Scapular Squeeze
desc: Prone on mat. Sweep arms from hips all the way overhead without allowing hands or forearms to touch the floor. Maximum scapular squeeze.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bradford Press (Bench)
desc: Seated on bench. Press dumbbells barely clearing crown of head from front collarbones to just behind ear level, continuous constant tension.

name: Dumbbell 20-Second Lateral Hold
desc: Hold dumbbells at shoulder level with parallel arms for an unbroken isometric static contraction. Breathe continuously without shrugging.

name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Front Raise (Bench)
desc: Sit tall on bench with back flat. Raise dumbbells with neutral thumbs-up hammer grip to shoulder height, lowering smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Incline Prone Reverse Fly (Bench)
desc: Lie chest down on 45-degree bench. Open arms in a sweeping hugging-in-reverse motion until pinkies lead the lift at shoulder level.

name: Dumbbell Floor Z-Press on Mat
desc: Sit flat on mat with legs spread wide in a V. Press dumbbells overhead with zero back support, forcing perfect vertical spinal stabilization.

name: Dumbbell Half-Kneeling Overhead Press (Mat)
desc: Kneel on mat with one knee down, opposite foot forward. Press dumbbell on down-knee side to full overhead extension with braced glutes.

name: Dumbbell Windmill Shoulder Stabilizer (Mat)
desc: Lock dumbbell overhead, eyes tracking weight. Hinge laterally toward mat with opposite hand sliding down shin, holding rotator cuff stable.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Waiter Isometric Hold
desc: Press dumbbell overhead with elbow fully locked and bicep close to ear. Hold isometric position for 30s while maintaining tight ribcage.

name: Dumbbell 90/90 External Rotation on Bench
desc: Sit on bench with knee raised, prop elbow on top of knee at 90 degrees. Rotate dumbbell upward from horizontal to vertical orientation.

name: Dumbbell 5-Second Eccentric Overhead Lowering
desc: Press dumbbells overhead quickly, then resist gravitational descent for a full 5-second slow eccentric negative back to collarbones.

name: Mat Dolphin Scapular Press
desc: From forearm plank on mat, walk feet forward into forearm pike. Drive chest back toward thighs, then press forward over forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Push Press
desc: Dip knees 5cm and drive aggressively through heels to propel dumbbell overhead to full arm lockout. Control eccentric lowering for 3s.

name: Dumbbell Standing Lu Raise (Lateral to Overhead)
desc: Raise light dumbbells through full 180-degree lateral arc until bells touch overhead, maintaining locked elbows and smooth 4s return.

name: Dumbbell Scaption Hold (30-Degree Anterior Plane)
desc: Raise dumbbells in scapular plane (30 degrees forward of midline) with thumbs up. Hold 3s at peak to maximize supraspinatus recruitment.

name: Dumbbell Standing Shrug with 2-Second Hold
desc: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides. Elevate shoulders straight up toward ears, clamp peak contraction for 2s, lower slowly without rolling.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shrug (Flat Bench)
desc: Sit at end of flat bench. Shrug dumbbells vertically with pure trap contraction, eliminating any leg drive or body momentum.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly with 2-Second Scapular Pinch
desc: Seated hinge on bench. Fly dumbbells out wide horizontally, pinch shoulder blades hard for 2 full seconds before 3s descent.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternating Shoulder Press (Bench)
desc: Sit back against bench. Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping opposite dumbbell held at shoulder height. Alternate every rep smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Incline Scapular Retraction Shrug (Bench)
desc: Prone on 45-degree bench with arms extended straight down toward floor. Shrug shoulder blades backward and together without bending elbows.

name: Dumbbell Russian Core Twist
desc: Sit on mat, lean torso back 45 degrees, rotate dumbbell smoothly side-to-side across midline with braced core.

name: Three-Quarter Sit-Up
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, arms crossed on your chest. Curl up until you are about three quarters of the way up, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Standing 45-Degree Side Bend
desc: Stand tall, hands behind your head. Lean slowly to one side about 45 degrees, then use your obliques to come back up. Alternate sides.

name: Bicycle Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, legs raised. Bring one elbow towards the opposite knee while the other leg straightens. Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.

name: Alternating Heel Touch
desc: Lie on your back with knees bent and shoulders lifted. Reach one hand down the side to touch your heel, then the other. Keep your shoulders off the mat.

name: Incline Side Plank (Bench)
desc: Put your forearm on the bench and your feet on the floor, body straight and side-on. Hold, keeping your hips lifted. Switch sides halfway.

name: Bottoms Up
desc: Lie on your back, legs straight up. Press your lower back into the mat and lift your hips a few centimetres towards the ceiling, then lower slowly.

name: Plank Butt-Up
desc: From a forearm plank, push your hips up high into a pike, then lower slowly back to a straight plank.

name: Cocoon Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, arms overhead and legs straight. Pull your knees in and arms forward to meet over your middle, then extend back out slowly.

name: Crab Toe Touch
desc: Sit with hands behind you and lift your hips into a crab. Lift one foot and touch it with the opposite hand. Alternate sides.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent. Crunch up and bring one shoulder towards the opposite knee, then lower. Alternate sides.

name: Floor Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, fingertips at your ears. Curl your shoulders off the mat, breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Dead Bug
desc: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg slowly towards the floor, keeping your lower back pressed down. Return and switch.

name: Bench Leg-Up Crunch
desc: Lie on the mat with your calves resting on the bench. Curl your shoulders up towards your knees, then lower slowly.

name: Bench-Anchored Sit-Up
desc: Lie on the mat with your feet hooked under the bench. Sit all the way up with control, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
desc: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand. Lean towards it, then pull yourself back upright using your opposite side. Switch sides each set.

name: Standing Elbow to Knee
desc: Stand with hands behind your head. Lift one knee and bring the opposite elbow to meet it. Alternate sides in a steady rhythm.

name: Bent-Knee Sit-Up
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, arms crossed. Sit up all the way, then lower slowly vertebra by vertebra.

name: Straight-Arm Sit-Up
desc: Lie on your back, arms reaching straight towards your knees. Sit up following your hands, then lower slowly.

name: Frog Crunch
desc: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out. Crunch up reaching towards your feet, then lower slowly.

name: Plank Hip Twist
desc: In a forearm plank, rotate your hips to dip one side towards the floor, then the other. Keep your shoulders still.

name: Knees-In Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, legs raised and bent. Crunch your shoulders up while pulling your knees in to meet them, then extend slowly.

name: Half Sit-Up
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent. Curl up halfway, hold for a moment, then lower slowly.

name: Inchworm
desc: Stand tall, bend down and walk your hands out to a high plank. Hold for a moment, then walk your hands back and stand up.

name: Bench-Anchored Twisting Sit-Up
desc: Hook your feet under the bench. Sit up and twist to bring one elbow towards the opposite knee, lower slowly, then twist the other way.

name: Jackknife
desc: Lie flat, arms overhead. Lift your arms and straight legs at the same time to meet over your hips, then lower slowly.

name: Janda Sit-Up
desc: Lie with knees bent and press your heels into the floor to switch off your hip flexors. Curl up slowly, then lower.

name: Knee Touch Crunch
desc: Lie with knees bent. Crunch up and slide your hands up your thighs until they touch your knees, then lower.

name: Kneeling Plank Shoulder Tap
desc: In a high plank on your knees, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand without rocking your hips.

name: L-Sit Hold (Dumbbell Handles)
desc: Sit with legs straight, hands on dumbbell handles beside your hips. Press down to lift your hips, and lift your heels if you can. Hold. Advanced.

name: Lunge With Twist
desc: Step forward into a lunge, then rotate your chest towards the front leg. Turn back, stand up and switch legs.

name: Lying Elbow to Knee
desc: Lie on your back, hands behind your head. Bring one elbow and the opposite knee together, then switch.

name: Slow Negative Crunch
desc: Start sitting up with knees bent. Lower yourself back towards the mat over five seconds, then sit back up with your hands.

name: Side-Lying Oblique Crunch
desc: Lie on your side with knees bent, top hand behind your head. Crunch your top elbow towards your hip, then lower.

name: Kneeling Dumbbell Woodchop
desc: Kneel on one knee holding a dumbbell with both hands by your hip. Chop it diagonally up across your body, then lower back over 3 seconds.

name: Dumbbell Chest-Hold Sit-Up
desc: Hold a dumbbell on your chest, knees bent. Sit up slowly, then lower back down with control.

name: Pelvic Tilt
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent. Flatten your lower back into the mat by tilting your pelvis, hold, then relax.

name: Plank With Arm Reach
desc: In a forearm plank, reach one arm straight ahead, hold for a second, then switch arms. Keep your hips level.

name: Hands-Behind-Head Half Sit-Up
desc: Fingers at your ears, knees bent. Curl up halfway, pause, then lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

name: Push-Up to Side Plank
desc: Do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank with one arm up. Return to the plank and switch sides next rep.

name: Quarter Sit-Up
desc: Lie with knees bent. Lift just your shoulder blades off the mat, pause, and lower slowly.

name: Reverse Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90 degrees. Curl your hips off the mat to bring your knees towards your chest, then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Plank Leg Lift
desc: Sit with legs straight and hands behind you. Lift your hips so your body is straight, then lift one leg. Alternate legs.

name: Russian Twist
desc: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly. Rotate your chest to touch the floor beside one hip, then the other.

name: Seated Side Crunch
desc: Sit on the bench, hands behind your head. Crunch to one side bringing your elbow towards your hip, then the other.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
desc: In a high plank with feet wide, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand. Keep your hips still and alternate.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
desc: Hold a side plank on your forearm. Lower your hip toward the mat over 2 seconds, then lift it back up. Switch sides halfway.

name: Alternating Toe Touch
desc: Stand with feet wide. Bend and reach one hand to the opposite foot, stand up, then switch sides.

name: Sit-Up (Arms Crossed)
desc: Lie with knees bent, arms crossed on your chest. Sit up all the way and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Spell Caster
desc: Hold a dumbbell in each hand by one hip. Swing both across your body to the other side in a smooth arc while keeping your hips facing forward.

name: Seated Spine Twist
desc: Sit tall with legs straight and arms out. Twist your upper body to one side, return, then twist to the other.

name: Tuck Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, knees tucked. Crunch up and hug your knees in, then lower slowly.

name: V-Sit Hold
desc: Balance on your tailbone with legs and chest lifted to make a V. Reach your arms forward and hold.

name: Dumbbell Crunch
desc: Hold a dumbbell on your chest, knees bent. Crunch up, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bench-Anchored Sit-Up
desc: Feet hooked under the bench, dumbbell on your chest. Sit up all the way, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell-Loaded Plank
desc: Hold a forearm plank. Hold a light dumbbell in one hand on the mat to add grip and core challenge. Keep your body straight and breathe.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist (Feet Up)
desc: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, lean back and lift your feet. Rotate side to side, touching the dumbbell beside each hip.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
desc: Sit with knees bent, holding a dumbbell. Lean back and rotate to touch it beside each hip, keeping your chest tall.

name: Dumbbell Russian Core Twist (Feet Elevated)
desc: Sit on mat with heels hovering 10cm. Rotate dumbbell side to side under strict 2s control, lightly tapping mat beside hip.

name: Dumbbell Mat Deadbug with Single-Arm Press
desc: Supine on mat in deadbug position. Hold dumbbell pressed overhead while extending opposite arm and leg straight to hover 5cm off mat.

name: Dumbbell Mat Bird-Dog Row
desc: Quadruped position on mat. Extend rear leg straight out while performing single-arm dumbbell row with opposite hand, hips square.

name: Dumbbell Hollow Body Isometric Hold on Mat
desc: Supine on mat with lower back glued flat. Hold light dumbbell overhead with legs hovering 15cm off floor in banana curve for 20s.

name: Dumbbell Mat Plank Pull-Through
desc: High plank position on mat. Reach underneath torso with opposite hand to drag dumbbell across floor, resisting any hip rotation.

name: Copenhagen Side Plank on Bench
desc: Side plank with top foot resting on flat bench and bottom leg hovering underneath. Brace lateral core and inner thigh for 20s.

name: Flat Bench Reverse Crunch & Leg Extension
desc: Lie on bench gripping top of bench behind head. Curl knees to chest lifting pelvis, then extend legs straight out in line with bench.

name: Dumbbell Straight-Leg Sit-Up on Mat
desc: Lie flat on mat with legs straight out. Hold dumbbell across collarbones and roll spine vertebra-by-vertebra into upright sitting posture.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Sit-Up to Vertical Press
desc: Sit up smoothly from mat while transitioning dumbbell from chest to full vertical press at top of rep. Lower with 3s eccentric cadence.

name: Mat Side Plank Hip Dip with Dumbbell
desc: Forearm side plank on mat with dumbbell resting on top hip. Dip hip 5cm toward mat, then drive up into high hyperextended arc.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Plank Static Hold
desc: Hold push-up plank with hands grasping dumbbell handles on mat. Lock core like concrete, resisting any pelvic tilt or wrist wobbling.

name: Dumbbell Standing Low-to-High Woodchopper
desc: Pivot on trail foot, rotate dumbbell from outside knee across body up over opposite shoulder in explosive athletic diagonal arc.

name: Dumbbell Standing High-to-Low Woodchopper
desc: Begin with dumbbell held high over shoulder, chop diagonally downward across torso past opposite hip, bracing core at bottom.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Side Oblique Bend
desc: Hold dumbbell in one hand only. Tilt torso laterally toward weight for 3s stretch, then contract opposite oblique to snap back upright.

name: Mat Flutter Kicks with Overhead Dumbbell Anchor
desc: Supine on mat holding dumbbell anchored overhead. Alternate rapid vertical flutter kicks with legs straight and toes pointed.

name: Mat Bicycle Crunch with 2-Second Hold
desc: Bring opposite elbow to knee, hold maximum cross-body isometric contraction for 2 full seconds before rotating smoothly to opposite side.

name: Dumbbell Turkish Get-Up (Mat Quarter Roll)
desc: Supine on mat with dumbbell locked overhead. Roll onto opposite elbow and up onto palm while keeping dumbbell locked perpendicular to mat.

name: Dumbbell Turkish Get-Up (Sit-to-Lunge Phase)
desc: From seated palm position, sweep bottom leg through into half-kneeling lunge while maintaining vertical dumbbell stabilization.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Anti-Rotational Chest Press
desc: Tall kneeling on mat. Press dumbbell horizontally straight out from sternum, freeze for 3s resisting any trunk twisting or sway.

name: Mat Spider Plank (Knee-to-Elbow Touch)
desc: In push-up plank on mat, drive knee laterally outward to touch outside of elbow. Hold 1s pause, return with control.
