name: Bench Flat Leg Raise with Hip Lift
desc: Lie flat on bench, raise straight legs to 90 degrees, then push soles of feet straight up toward ceiling lifting lower back off bench.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Diagonal Woodchopper
desc: Kneel tall on mat with both knees down. Rotate dumbbell from outside hip across torso up past opposite ear, locking pelvis forward.

name: Mat Dumbbell Anchor Windshield Wipers
desc: Supine on mat holding heavy dumbbell overhead as an anchor. Sweep straight legs side-to-side in controlled 45-degree arcs.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry High-Knee March
desc: Hold heavy dumbbell in one hand only. Perform high-knee march on mat maintaining upright posture without leaning toward or away from weight.

name: Single-Arm Bench-Supported Row
desc: Put one knee and hand on the bench, back flat. Pull the dumbbell up to your hip, pause, then lower slowly to a full stretch. Finish one side, then switch.

name: Two-Arm Bent-Over Neutral-Grip Row
desc: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back, palms facing each other. Row both dumbbells to your ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

name: Bent-Over Underhand Row
desc: Hinge forward with palms facing forward. Pull the dumbbells to your waist with elbows close, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Prone Bench Seal Row
desc: Lie chest-down on a flat bench, arms straight down. Row both dumbbells up towards the bench, pause with your shoulder blades squeezed, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row From Floor
desc: Hinge until your back is nearly flat, dumbbells on the floor. Pull them sharply to your ribs, then lower them back to the floor under control. Reset each rep.

name: Tripod Single-Arm Row
desc: Stand in a split stance with one hand on the bench. Row the dumbbell to your hip and lower slowly. Keep your hips square.

name: Dumbbell Gorilla Row
desc: Stand wide with dumbbells on the floor between your feet, hips back. Row one dumbbell up while the other stays down, then alternate.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Row
desc: Kneel on one knee, lean forward slightly with a flat back. Row the dumbbell to your hip on the kneeling side and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Row With 3-Second Hold
desc: Support yourself on the bench and row the dumbbell to your hip. Hold it there for three seconds, then lower slowly. Great for tendon strength.

name: Bent-Over Wide Row
desc: Hinge forward, palms facing back. Pull the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to shoulder level, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Hammer Row
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, palms facing in. Row both dumbbells up, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Bench Back Extension
desc: Lie face down across the bench with your hips on the edge and your feet anchored on the floor. Lower your chest slowly, then lift until your body is straight.

name: Prone Floor Lat Pull
desc: Lie face down with light dumbbells in front of you. Lift your chest and arms, then pull your elbows down to your sides as if doing a pull-up. Reach forward again slowly.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift to Row
desc: Hinge down with the dumbbells and stand up tall. Hinge again, pause halfway and row both dumbbells to your ribs, then stand up. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
desc: Hold one dumbbell against your chest. Push your hips back with soft knees until your back is nearly parallel to the floor, then squeeze your glutes to stand.

name: Single-Arm Bench Row With Rotation
desc: With one hand on the bench, row the dumbbell up and rotate your chest open at the top. Return slowly to the start.

name: Kneeling Bench Rear Delt Row
desc: Support yourself on the bench, palm facing back. Pull the dumbbell up and out with the elbow wide, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row Isometric Hold
desc: Hinge forward and row both dumbbells to your ribs. Hold that top position, breathing steadily, for the set time.

name: Dumbbell Pullover on Floor (Slow)
desc: Lie on your back with one dumbbell held over your chest. Lower it behind your head over three seconds with soft elbows, then pull it back over your chest.

name: Bench Single-Arm Lat Pullover
desc: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest. Lower it slowly behind your head until you feel the lats stretch, then pull it back up.

name: Prone Y-T Raise on Bench
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with light dumbbells. Raise your arms into a Y, lower, then raise them out to a T. Move slowly.

name: Hammer Curl to Reverse Curl
desc: Do one hammer curl with palms facing in, then one curl with palms facing down. Alternate the grip each rep, lowering slowly.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl (Slow)
desc: Curl one dumbbell across your body towards the opposite shoulder, palm facing in. Lower over three seconds, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl on Incline Bench
desc: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with arms straight down. Curl both dumbbells up, squeeze for one second, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
desc: Sit tall on the bench holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head slowly, then straighten your arms.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
desc: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand. Lower it behind your head with the elbow pointing up, then straighten. Switch arms.

name: Bench Dumbbell Skull Crusher
desc: Lie on the bench, dumbbells over your shoulders, palms in. Bend only your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head, then straighten.

name: Floor Skull Crusher
desc: Lie on the mat with dumbbells over your shoulders. Lower them beside your head by bending the elbows, then press back up.

name: Incline Bench Skull Crusher
desc: Lie on an incline bench. Lower the dumbbells behind your head slowly with elbows pointing up, then straighten.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
desc: Hinge forward, upper arms tight to your sides. Straighten your elbows to push the dumbbells back, squeeze, then bend slowly.

name: Bench-Supported Single-Arm Kickback
desc: One hand and knee on the bench. Keep the upper arm still and straighten the elbow to push the dumbbell back, then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
desc: Lie on the bench, dumbbells touching, palms in. Press up and lower slowly with elbows close to your body.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
desc: Lie on the bench and press the dumbbells together hard over your chest. Keep squeezing as you lower and press them.

name: Incline Squeeze Press
desc: On an incline bench, squeeze the dumbbells together and press them up. Lower slowly while keeping them pressed together.

name: Paused Dumbbell Bench Press
desc: Lower the dumbbells to your chest over two seconds and hold for two seconds at the bottom. Press up without bouncing.

name: Lying Cross-Body Triceps Extension
desc: Lie on the bench, one dumbbell over your shoulder. Lower it across your body towards the opposite shoulder, then straighten.

name: Floor Triceps Press (Neutral Grip)
desc: Lie on the mat, palms in, elbows tight. Press the dumbbells up and lower until your elbows touch the floor.

name: Close-Grip Kneeling Push-Up
desc: On your knees, hands just narrower than your shoulders. Lower slowly with elbows close to your sides, then press up.

name: Slow Negative Push-Up
desc: From the top of a push-up, lower yourself over five seconds. Drop your knees to get back up and repeat.

name: Bottom Push-Up Isometric Hold
desc: Lower into a push-up and stop with your chest just above the floor. Hold there with your body straight and breathe.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press on Floor
desc: Lie on the mat, dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your feet. Bend your elbows outwards to lower the dumbbells to your chest, then press up.

name: Incline Bench Triceps Extension (Both Arms)
desc: Sit on an incline bench holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head and straighten your arms.

name: Kneeling Bench Triceps Dip
desc: Hands on the bench behind you, legs bent and close. Dip slowly to 90 degrees at the elbow and press up. Easier than the straight-leg dip.

name: Bird Dog
desc: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight. Hold for a second, return slowly and switch sides.

name: Bodyweight Dead Bug (Slow)
desc: Lie on your back, arms up and knees at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg over three seconds, keeping your back flat, then switch.

name: Dumbbell Dead Bug
desc: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand over your chest. Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg towards the floor, then return and switch.

name: Hollow Body Rock
desc: Hold a hollow position with arms and legs reaching long. Rock gently forward and back without losing the shape.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry March
desc: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side. March on the spot slowly, standing perfectly straight without leaning. Switch hands halfway.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Carry March
desc: Press one dumbbell overhead and lock your arm. March slowly on the spot with your ribs down. Switch arms halfway.

name: Bear Plank Hold
desc: On hands and knees, lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor. Hold with a flat back and breathe.

name: Bear Plank Shoulder Tap
desc: From a bear plank with knees hovering, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand. Alternate without rocking.

name: Bench Reverse Crunch
desc: Lie on the bench holding the end behind your head. Curl your hips up to bring your knees to your chest, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Bench Knee Tuck
desc: Sit on the end of the bench, lean back on your hands. Pull your knees in to your chest, then extend your legs out slowly.

name: Plank Up-Down
desc: From a forearm plank, push up onto one hand then the other into a high plank. Lower back down one arm at a time.

name: Plank With Dumbbell Drag
desc: In a high plank with a dumbbell beside you, reach under your body and drag it to the other side. Alternate hands.

name: Side Plank Reach-Through
desc: In a side plank, reach your top arm under your body, then sweep it up to the ceiling. Switch sides halfway.

name: Half-Kneeling Dumbbell Halo
desc: Kneel on one knee holding a dumbbell by the horns. Circle it slowly around your head, keeping your ribs down. Change direction halfway.

name: Slow Bicycle Crunch
desc: Lie on your back, hands behind your head. Slowly bring one elbow to the opposite knee, pause, then switch.

name: Mat Leg Raise
desc: Lie flat with your hands under your hips. Raise your straight legs to vertical, then lower them slowly without arching your back.

name: Flutter Kicks
desc: Lie on your back with legs straight and lifted a little. Kick them up and down in small quick movements, lower back pressed down.

name: Forearm Plank (Core)
desc: Elbows under shoulders, body straight from head to heels. Brace your stomach, squeeze your glutes and hold, breathing slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front-Rack Squat
desc: Hold the dumbbells at your shoulders, elbows forward. Squat down slowly with your chest tall, then drive up.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
desc: Stand in a long split stance with dumbbells at your sides. Lower your back knee straight down towards the floor, then press up. Finish one side.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
desc: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Step wide to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, other leg straight. Push back and alternate.

name: Bench Dumbbell Hip Thrust
desc: Sit with your upper back against the bench and a dumbbell on your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is flat, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
desc: Stand wide, toes out, holding one dumbbell between your legs. Sit down with a flat back until it nears the floor, then stand up.

name: Lateral Bench Step-Down
desc: Stand side-on on the bench. Slowly lower the outside heel towards the floor by bending the standing knee, then press back up.

name: Bench Box Squat
desc: Stand in front of the bench. Sit back slowly until you lightly touch it, then stand up without rocking.

name: Dumbbell Pause Squat
desc: Hold a dumbbell at your chest. Squat down over three seconds, hold the bottom for three seconds, then stand.

name: Dumbbell Wall Sit
desc: Back flat on a wall, dumbbells resting on your thighs. Slide down until your knees are at 90 degrees and hold.

name: Single-Leg Squat to Bench
desc: Stand in front of the bench on one leg. Lower slowly to sit, then stand back up on the same leg. Switch legs.

name: Heels-Elevated Narrow Goblet Squat
desc: Rest your heels on a small dumbbell, feet close. Hold a dumbbell at your chest and squat deep and slow, knees going forward.

name: Glute Bridge Hold
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders and hold, squeezing your glutes.

name: Clamshell
desc: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together. Lift your top knee while keeping your feet touching, then lower slowly.

name: Fire Hydrant
desc: On hands and knees, lift one bent knee out to the side to hip height, then lower slowly. Finish one side, then switch.

name: Donkey Kick
desc: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent and push one foot up towards the ceiling. Squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Lateral Bench Step-Up
desc: Stand beside the bench. Step sideways onto it and drive up to stand, then step down slowly. Switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge With Pause
desc: Step back into a lunge, hold the bottom for two seconds, then drive back up. Alternate legs.

name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Slow)
desc: Hold a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg. Hinge over three seconds as your free leg reaches back, then stand up.

name: Bodyweight Squat (5-Second Tempo)
desc: Lower into a squat over two seconds, pause for one, and stand up over two. Arms forward for balance.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (Bodyweight)
desc: Lie with one foot planted and the other leg straight. Drive up through the planted heel, squeeze, then lower slowly. Switch legs.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Shoulder Press
desc: Kneel on one knee and press the dumbbell overhead on the same side as the down knee. Lower slowly, keeping your ribs down.

name: Dumbbell Y-Press
desc: Press the dumbbells up and out into a Y shape overhead. Lower slowly back to your shoulders.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
desc: Hinge forward with a flat back. Raise light dumbbells out to the sides with soft elbows, squeeze, and lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Rear Delt Raise (Slow)
desc: Lie on your side, top arm across your body holding a light dumbbell. Raise it up to the ceiling over two seconds and lower over three.

name: Standing External Rotation (Elbow at Side)
desc: Tuck your elbow to your side at 90 degrees with a light dumbbell across your body. Rotate it out to the side, keeping the elbow in, then return slowly.

name: Prone External Rotation on Bench
desc: Lie chest-down on the bench, upper arm out to the side and elbow bent down. Rotate the forearm up until level with the bench, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise (Slow Lowering)
desc: Raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, then lower over four seconds.

name: Seated Lateral Raise Isometric Hold
desc: Sit and raise light dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height. Hold them there, breathing steadily.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row (Wide, Slow)
desc: Hold the dumbbells wide and pull them up to lower-chest height, elbows out. Lower over three seconds.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shrug Hold
desc: Sit on the bench with heavy dumbbells at your sides. Shrug up and hold the top position, breathing steadily.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise (Alternating)
desc: Raise one dumbbell straight in front to shoulder height, lower slowly, then the other.

name: Wrist Extensor Eccentric (Tennis Elbow)
desc: Rest your forearm on your thigh, palm down. Use your other hand to help lift the dumbbell up, then lower it on its own over five seconds.

name: Wrist Flexor Eccentric (Golfer's Elbow)
desc: Rest your forearm on your thigh, palm up. Help the dumbbell up with your other hand, then lower it slowly over five seconds.

name: Isometric Hammer Curl Hold (90 Degrees)
desc: Hold the dumbbells with elbows bent at 90 degrees, palms in. Hold still and breathe. Isometrics calm a sore tendon.

name: Isometric Calf Raise Hold
desc: Rise halfway onto your toes holding dumbbells and hold that position, breathing steadily.

name: Split Squat Isometric Hold (Patellar)
desc: Lower into a split squat with your front knee at 90 degrees. Hold still with an upright chest and breathe.

name: Eccentric Single-Leg Squat to Bench
desc: Stand on one leg in front of the bench and lower over five seconds to sit. Stand up with both legs and repeat.

name: Isometric External Rotation Hold
desc: Elbow at your side at 90 degrees, rotate a light dumbbell out halfway and hold still, breathing steadily.

name: Short-Lever Copenhagen Hold
desc: Lie on your side with your top knee resting on the bench. Lift your hips so your body is straight and hold.

name: Wall Tibialis Raise
desc: Lean your back against a wall with your heels forward. Lift your toes towards your shins, then lower slowly.

name: Glute Bridge Isometric Hold (Hamstrings)
desc: Lift into a glute bridge with your heels further away than usual. Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Slow Eccentric Lateral Raise
desc: Raise light dumbbells to the sides, then lower them over five seconds. Builds rotator cuff tendon strength.

name: Seated Isometric Knee Extension
desc: Sit on the bench and straighten one leg out in front. Tense your thigh hard and hold. Switch legs.

name: Jumping Jacks
desc: Jump your feet out as your arms swing overhead, then jump back together. Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Step Jacks (Low Impact)
desc: Step one foot out to the side as your arms rise overhead, step back in, then the other side. No jumping.

name: Seal Jacks
desc: Jump your feet out while opening your arms wide at shoulder height, then jump in and clap your hands in front of you.

name: Half Jacks
desc: Jump your feet out and in while your arms only rise to shoulder height. Quick and light.

name: Star Jumps
desc: Crouch down, then jump up spreading your arms and legs into a star. Land softly with bent knees.

name: High Knees
desc: Run on the spot, driving your knees up to hip height and pumping your arms.

name: Marching High Knees (Low Impact)
desc: March on the spot, lifting each knee to hip height with a strong arm swing. No jumping.

name: Butt Kicks
desc: Jog on the spot, kicking your heels up towards your glutes. Stay light on your toes.

name: Mountain Climbers
desc: From a high plank, drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs quickly. Keep your hips low.

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climbers
desc: From a high plank, drive each knee towards the opposite elbow, alternating quickly.

name: Slow Mountain Climbers
desc: From a high plank, bring one knee in slowly, place it back, then the other. Keep your body still.

name: Spiderman Climbers
desc: From a high plank, bring one knee out to the side towards your elbow, return, then switch.

name: Burpee
desc: Squat, put your hands down, jump your feet back to a plank, jump them in, then jump up with arms overhead.

name: Step-Back Burpee (Low Impact)
desc: Squat and place your hands down. Step back to a plank one foot at a time, step back in and stand up.

name: Burpee With Push-Up
desc: Do a burpee, adding a push-up when you reach the plank. Jump up at the end.

name: Half Burpee
desc: Squat, hands down, jump your feet back to a plank and back in, then stand. No jump at the top.

name: Dumbbell Burpee Deadlift
desc: With hands on the dumbbells, jump back to a plank and in again, then deadlift the dumbbells to standing.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
desc: Hold the dumbbells at your shoulders. Squat down, then drive up and press them overhead in one move. Lower to your shoulders.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Thruster
desc: Hold one dumbbell at your shoulder. Squat, then drive up and press it overhead. Switch arms halfway.

name: Two-Hand Dumbbell Swing
desc: Hold one dumbbell by the end with both hands. Hinge back to swing it between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Swing
desc: Swing one dumbbell between your legs and up to chest height with a hip snap. Switch hands halfway.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Snatch
desc: Hinge with one dumbbell between your feet, then drive up and punch it overhead. Lower and switch hands each rep.

name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
desc: Clean the dumbbells from your knees to your shoulders, press them overhead, then lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
desc: Start with the dumbbells at your knees. Drive your hips forward and pull them up to your shoulders, catching with soft knees.

name: Dumbbell Squat Clean
desc: Clean the dumbbells to your shoulders and drop straight into a squat, then stand up. Lower and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Squat to Press
desc: Squat with dumbbells at your shoulders, stand up, then press them overhead. A slower version of the thruster.

name: Dumbbell Devil Press
desc: Burpee down with your hands on the dumbbells, jump in, then swing them from the floor to overhead in one move.

name: Dumbbell Man Maker
desc: Push-up on the dumbbells, row each side, jump your feet in, clean the dumbbells and press them overhead.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
desc: In a high plank holding the dumbbells, row one to your hip, put it down, then row the other. Keep your hips still.

name: Plank Jacks
desc: In a high plank, jump your feet out wide and back together like a jumping jack.

name: Plank Up-Downs
desc: Move from a forearm plank to a high plank one arm at a time, then back down. Alternate the leading arm.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps (Fast)
desc: In a high plank with feet wide, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand quickly without rocking.

name: Bear Crawl in Place
desc: On hands and toes with knees hovering, step one hand and the opposite foot forward, then back. Alternate.

name: Inchworm Walkout
desc: Fold forward, walk your hands out to a plank, then walk them back and stand tall.

name: Inchworm With Push-Up
desc: Walk your hands out to a plank, do a push-up, walk back and stand up.

name: Skater Hops
desc: Leap sideways onto one foot, swinging the other leg behind, then leap back to the other side.

name: Skater Steps (Low Impact)
desc: Step wide to one side and sweep the other leg behind you into a curtsy, then step to the other side.

name: Lateral Shuffle
desc: Stay low in a half squat and shuffle three steps to one side, then three back. Keep your feet apart.

name: Squat Jacks
desc: Jump your feet wide into a squat, then jump them back together as you stand.

name: Jump Squats
desc: Squat down, then jump up explosively. Land softly and go straight into the next squat.

name: Tuck Jumps
desc: Jump straight up and pull your knees towards your chest. Land softly and reset.

name: Frog Jumps
desc: Squat low with hands between your feet, jump forward, land in the squat, then step back and repeat.

name: Broad Jump and Walk Back
desc: Swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can, land softly, then walk back.

name: Speed Squats
desc: Squat until your thighs are level with the floor and stand up quickly. Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.

name: Pulse Squats
desc: Stay low in a squat and pulse up and down a few centimetres.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat Pulses
desc: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, sink into a squat and pulse up and down a short distance.

name: Jumping Lunges
desc: From a lunge, jump and switch legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge.

name: Reverse Lunge to Knee Drive
desc: Step back into a lunge, then drive the back knee up to hip height as you stand. Alternate legs.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge to Press
desc: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders. Step back into a lunge, stand up and press overhead. Alternate legs.

name: Alternating Lateral Lunges
desc: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip, push back, then the other side.

name: Curtsy Lunge Steps
desc: Step one leg diagonally behind into a curtsy lunge, return, then switch.

name: Bench Step-Ups (Fast)
desc: Step up onto the bench and back down quickly, leading with the same leg for half the set, then switch.

name: Bench Step-Up With Knee Drive
desc: Step onto the bench and drive the other knee up high. Step down and repeat. Switch legs halfway.

name: Bench Lateral Step-Overs
desc: Stand beside the bench, step up and over to the other side, then back. Keep a steady rhythm.

name: Bench Toe Taps
desc: Stand facing the bench and quickly tap the top with alternating feet, like running on the spot.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up to Press
desc: Step up onto the bench holding dumbbells at your shoulders, press them overhead at the top, then step down.

name: Shadow Boxing With Light Dumbbells
desc: Hold very light dumbbells. Throw quick straight punches, alternating hands, staying light on your feet. Don't lock your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Cross Punches
desc: Punch across your body with light dumbbells, pivoting your back foot. Alternate arms.

name: Dumbbell Uppercuts
desc: With light dumbbells, drive upward punches from your hips, alternating hands and turning your torso.

name: Squat and Punch Combo
desc: Squat down, stand up and throw two quick punches with light dumbbells. Repeat.

name: Wall Sit With Punches
desc: Hold a wall sit with your thighs level. Punch light dumbbells forward, alternating hands, while your back stays flat on the wall.

name: Fast Feet
desc: In an athletic stance, run your feet on the spot as fast as you can, staying on your toes.

name: Skipping in Place
desc: Jump lightly on the balls of your feet as if skipping, turning your wrists in small circles at your sides.

name: Side-to-Side Hops
desc: Feet together, hop side to side over an imaginary line. Land softly.

name: Forward-Back Hops
desc: Keep your feet together and hop forward and back over an imaginary line on the floor. Stay light on the balls of your feet.

name: Pogo Hops
desc: Bounce on the balls of your feet with stiff ankles, staying light and quick.

name: Squat to Calf Raise
desc: Squat down, stand up and rise onto your toes at the top. Lower your heels and repeat.

name: Standing Cross-Body Knee Drive
desc: Hands behind your head, drive one knee across to the opposite elbow, then switch.

name: Standing Oblique Knee Crunch
desc: Raise one knee out to the side and bring the same elbow down to meet it. Switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Woodchop (Fast)
desc: Hold one dumbbell with both hands. Chop it diagonally from high to low across your body. Switch sides halfway.

name: Dumbbell High Pull
desc: Hinge slightly, then drive your hips forward and pull the dumbbells up to chest height, elbows high. Lower and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Sumo High Pull
desc: Stand wide holding one dumbbell. Squat down, then stand up fast and pull it to your chin.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift to Upright Row
desc: Deadlift the dumbbells to standing, then pull them up to your chest. Lower and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Push Press (Fast)
desc: Dip your knees and drive the dumbbells overhead using your legs. Lower to your shoulders and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's March
desc: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides and march briskly on the spot, standing tall.

name: Overhead Dumbbell March
desc: Hold one light dumbbell overhead and march on the spot. Switch arms halfway.

name: Squat Thrusts
desc: Squat and place your hands down, jump your feet back to a plank, then jump them back in. Stay low.

name: Crab Toe Touches
desc: In a crab position, kick one leg up and touch it with the opposite hand. Alternate.

name: Bicycle Crunches (Fast)
desc: Pedal your legs and bring each elbow towards the opposite knee in a quick, controlled rhythm.

name: Flutter Kick Intervals
desc: Lie flat, legs lifted a little, and kick them up and down quickly with your lower back pressed down.

name: Hollow Rocks
desc: Hold a hollow body shape with arms and legs reaching long, and rock gently forward and back without losing the shape.

name: V-Ups
desc: Lie flat, then lift your arms and straight legs to meet in a V. Lower slowly.

name: Russian Twist (Fast)
desc: Sit leaning back and twist quickly from side to side, touching the floor by each hip.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist (Fast)
desc: Hold a light dumbbell and twist side to side, tapping it beside each hip.

name: Kneeling to Standing
desc: From kneeling, step one foot up then the other to stand, then step back down to kneel. Alternate the lead leg.

name: Dumbbell Complex: Row, Clean, Press
desc: Do one bent-over row, one clean to the shoulders and one press overhead without putting the dumbbells down. That is one rep.

name: Dumbbell Complex: Deadlift, Squat, Press
desc: Deadlift, clean to your shoulders, squat, then press overhead. Lower and repeat. One of each is one rep.

name: Dumbbell Squat Jump (Light)
desc: Hold light dumbbells at your sides. Squat down, jump up, and land softly back into the squat before the next rep.

name: Push-Up to T-Rotation
desc: Do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank with one arm up. Return and alternate sides.

name: Plank Walk-Up
desc: From a forearm plank, push up onto your hands one at a time, then lower back down.

name: Bench Push-Up Burpee
desc: Hands on the bench, jump or step your feet back, do an incline push-up, step in and stand.

name: Bench Jump-Overs (Hands On)
desc: Put your hands on the bench and hop both feet from one side to the other.

name: Dumbbell Halo Squat
desc: Circle the dumbbell around your head, then do a squat. Alternate the circle direction each rep.

name: Lunge Pulses
desc: Stay in a split stance and pulse up and down a few centimetres. Switch legs halfway.

name: Wall Sit Hold (Cardio Finisher)
desc: Slide down a wall until your thighs are level and hold, breathing steadily.

name: High Plank Hold (Cardio Finisher)
desc: Hold a straight-arm plank with your body in one line, breathing steadily.

name: Shoulder Press Pulses
desc: With light dumbbells just above your shoulders, pulse them up and down a short distance quickly.

name: Lateral Raise Pulses
desc: Raise light dumbbells to shoulder height and pulse them up and down a few centimetres.

name: Dumbbell Swing to Squat
desc: Do one dumbbell swing, then hold it at your chest and squat. Alternate swing and squat.

name: Low-Impact Cardio Boxer Shuffle
desc: Bounce lightly from foot to foot in a boxer's stance with your hands up.

name: Jumping Jacks
desc: Jump your feet out wide as your arms swing overhead, then jump back together. Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Arm Circles
desc: Arms out to the sides at shoulder height. Draw small circles, growing bigger. Halfway through, reverse the direction.

name: Leg Swings
desc: Hold a wall for balance. Swing one leg forward and back, relaxed and controlled. Switch legs halfway through.

name: High Knees
desc: Jog on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height. Pump your arms and stay light on your feet.

name: Standing Side Bends
desc: Reach both arms overhead and lean gently to one side, then the other. Keep your hips still and breathe out as you bend.

name: Warm-up Air Squats
desc: Feet shoulder width apart. Sit your hips back and down, arms forward for balance, then stand tall. Easy range to start, deeper each rep.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
desc: Sit with your legs straight out in front. Hinge forward from the hips and reach towards your toes until you feel a gentle stretch. Relax and breathe.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
desc: Stand tall and pull one heel towards your glutes, knees together. Hold a wall if you need balance. Switch legs halfway.

name: Standing Chest Opener
desc: Clasp your hands behind your back, straighten your arms and lift your chest. Squeeze your shoulder blades gently together.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
primaryMuscles: Rear Shoulders, Rotator Cuff, Upper Back
desc: Bring one arm across your chest and hug it in with the other arm. Keep the shoulder down. Switch arms halfway.

name: Child's Pose
desc: Kneel, sit your hips back to your heels and walk your hands forward. Rest your forehead on the mat and breathe into your back.

name: Lying Knee-to-Chest Stretch
desc: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor. Hug the other knee towards your chest and relax your shoulders. Switch legs halfway.

name: Box Breathing
desc: Lie on your back, knees bent. Breathe in for four seconds, hold for two, and breathe out for four. Let your heart rate come down.

name: Bodyweight Air Squat
desc: Feet shoulder width apart, arms forward. Lower slowly for two seconds, pause at the bottom, then stand up tall.

name: Push-Up
desc: Hands under your shoulders, body in one straight line. Lower your chest to the floor slowly, pause, then press back up. Drop to your knees to make it easier.

name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
desc: Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor. Pause, then push through the front heel to stand. Alternate legs.

name: Superman Raise
desc: Lie face down, arms forward. Lift your arms, chest and legs off the mat, hold, then lower slowly.

name: Forearm Plank
desc: Elbows under your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your glutes and brace your stomach. Breathe.

name: Side Plank
desc: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder. Lift your hips so your body is straight. Switch sides halfway.

name: Mountain Climbers
desc: Start in a high plank. Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs in a steady running rhythm. Keep your hips low.

name: Wall Sit (Isometric)
desc: Back flat against a wall, slide down until your knees are at ninety degrees. Hold still. A long hold loads the patellar tendon safely.

name: Dead Hang
desc: Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and hang with straight arms. Relax your legs, keep your shoulders active. Step down when your grip fades.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
desc: Hang with straight arms. Pull your shoulder blades down and back to lift your body a few centimetres, hold, then lower slowly.

name: Flexed-Arm Hang
desc: Step or jump up so your chin is over the bar. Hold there with your elbows bent and chest up, then lower slowly to finish.

name: Negative Pull-Up
desc: Step up so your chin is over the bar. Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arms are straight, then step back up and repeat.

name: Pull-Up
desc: Hang with straight arms. Pull your chest towards the bar until your chin is over it, pause, then lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
desc: Hang from the bar. Raise your knees up to hip height without swinging, pause, then lower them slowly.
